title: Brand Manager, Kitchen, Kitchen
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Brand Manager, you will focus on delivering 2 key areas - Brand Management and growth, and Program management to drive profitability.
  
  
We are looking for high-potential, innovative, and a results oriented professional to join Amazon who can work in ambiguous situations and chart the way forward. By joining as a Program Manager for the Kitchen Category, you will drive high-visibility and strategic programs as well as leverage Analytics to lead process improvement initiatives. And will be equally comfortable digging into business requirements as you are driving operational efficiencies.  
  
We are looking for candidates with a strong record of owning and executing strategic, cross-functional projects as well as partnering with other teams to drive key process improvement programs. This role requires working with business teams across the company to provide data driven operations support - key to the success of the category profitability and best in class customer experience. This is an opportunity that requires a critical thinker with strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills. At the core of the position is passion for protecting Amazon’s reputation, delivering par excellence Customer Experience and making it the preferred choice for millions of buyers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
This person will have responsibility for:  
  
Building selection: Identify selection gaps. Track brand’s offline catalogue to ensure all relevant selection is present on Amazon.  
  
Demand generation: Responsible for demand generation. This includes working with other members on the category management team to create a marketing calendar based on vendor's objectives  
  
Define and execute tactical and strategic plans towards achieving the program vision and goals through efficient program, operations and stakeholder management  
  
Develop team goals and metrics that allow for accurate measurement and traction towards solving a business problem, achieve buy-in from stakeholders and actively report progress on the goals  
  
Work with program, supply chain operations, and product management teams to understand program requirements and jointly develop a solution which solves a larger business problem  
  
Continuously perform data based Analytics to identify issues and report key insights, subsequently building data backed business cases  
  
Develop and maintain key relationships with internal stakeholders locally and around the world

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
* 2+ years of market research analyst, product manager, or equivalent experience
* 2+ years of doing one of several roles: quantitative/financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, pricing, marketing or e-commerce experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration
* Experience leading cross-functional projects and implementing strategic initiatives
* Experience in Retail, FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods), or a client/vendor-facing environment such as sales or negotiation
* Experience owning end-to-end account or business performance outcomes
* Experience managing or influencing senior stakeholders in a commercial or client-facing context

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of doing one of several roles: management consulting, investment banking analyst/associate, or brand manager role at leading consumer packaged goods company experience
* Experience in financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, marketing, business development, consulting, negotiation or supply chain

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
### **Job Information**

### **About Us**

CloudifyOps is a company with **DevOps** and **Cloud** in our DNA. CloudifyOps enables businesses to become more agile and innovative through a comprehensive portfolio of services that addresses hybrid IT transformation, Cloud transformation, and end-to-end DevOps Workflows.

We are a proud Advance Partner of Amazon Web Services and have deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform solutions.

We are passionate about what we do. The novelty and the excitement of helping our customers accomplish their goals drives us to become excellent at what we do.

  

### **Job Description**

**W****ho we are**

CloudifyOps is an AI & Digital Transformation partner. We pair over a decade of mission-critical cloud and DevOps engineering with strategic AI consulting, custom AI development, and managed operations - helping businesses modernize their IT infrastructure, optimize cloud operations, and accelerate software delivery through automation and best practices.

Beyond client services, we build our own products - MIXIMO, Lens, and DevOptymize - and run always-on Cloud, AI and Site Reliability operations for global clients across FinTech, EdTech, Healthcare, Automotive and Media Tech.

**Culture at CloudifyOps**

Working at CloudifyOps is a rewarding experience. We're built around five values - **Ownership, Transparency, Learning, One Team, and Performance** - and you'll feel them in how work actually gets done here, not just in a poster on the wall.

Great people, a work environment that thrives on creativity, a career path designed around feedback and progress - as well as the opportunity to take on roles beyond a defined job description are just some of the reasons you should work with us.

**About the Role**  
  
As an Associate Technical Project Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of customer projects across cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure, and AI engagements. You will work alongside Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers to translate an approved solution into a planned, tracked, and governed delivery - and you will be the primary point of contact the customer relies on for progress, risks, and decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of technology and delivery governance. You are expected to understand the technical solution well enough to challenge estimates, spot dependencies early, and hold both the team and the customer to agreed scope, effort, and timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning**

* Review project proposals to ensure in-scope and out-of-scope items, effort and cost estimation, deliverables, assumptions, and the proposed architecture are clearly defined.
* Analyze project requirements and prepare or update project timelines, delivery methodology, RACI, milestones, and deliverables.
* Ensure use cases and test cases are clearly defined before the project is onboarded to the delivery team.
* Prepare the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) before implementation and review it with the Technical Lead.
* Establish timelines and milestones and plan delivery within the approved budget.

**Technical Project Management**

* Develop a sound understanding of the technical deliverables and work closely with Architects and Technical Leads to identify and manage risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Regularly review the technical solution and implementation progress with the Technical Lead to ensure planned activities are completed within the agreed timeline.
* Track project scope, schedule, effort, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per agreed scope.
* Assess project risks, develop risk mitigation strategies, and implement contingency plans to minimize the impact of potential issues.
* Identify project blockers and follow the defined escalation hierarchy for timely resolution.

**Delivery Across Project Types**

* **Migration and cloud projects:** Manage end-to-end delivery of cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure projects, tracking cloud-specific activities, technical dependencies, risks, and milestones with Architects and Technical Leads.
* **Non-migration technical projects:** Manage end-to-end delivery of AI PoC implementations, AI assessments, and similar engagements, ensuring requirements, use cases, test cases, technical deliverables, and timelines are clearly defined and aligned with the approved solution.
* Coordinate with the technical teams responsible for moving applications between Development, Test, Integration, and Production environments.
* Manage change requests across cloud migration activities and track all associated events to maximize system availability and avoid errors.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate and conduct regular daily stand-ups and customer meetings, and maintain meeting minutes, action items, expectations, and discussion points.
* Prepare and share weekly project status reports covering progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and next steps.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination between customers, Sales, Architects, Technical Leads, Engineers, and other stakeholders.
* Keep clients, executives, and external partners engaged throughout the project lifecycle to sustain involvement and satisfaction.

**Project Governance & Documentation**

* Maintain key project documentation, including WBS, RACI, risk and issue registers, meeting minutes, status reports, decision and action trackers, and project closure documents.
* Ensure project activities and deliverables remain aligned with the approved scope, timeline, effort, and customer expectations.
* Drive project closure activities and ensure required deliverables, customer confirmation or sign-off, and closure documentation are completed.

**Effort & Commercial Management**

* Review team timesheets and effort utilization against approved project estimates, and maintain in line with agreed effort hours.
* Track project consumption and proactively highlight any effort or budget deviations.
* Obtain the final project consumption from the customer and coordinate with the Sales team for invoicing and partner-center billing.

**Team Leadership & Reporting**

* Provide leadership and guidance to project teams, facilitate collaboration, resolve conflicts, and motivate team members to achieve project objectives.
* Drive difficult conversations with both customers and team members when a project needs to be brought back on track.
* Generate weekly and monthly reports aligned with the relevant metrics for each type of project - for example, resource utilization, technical evaluation of team members, and customer success data points.

**What You Bring**

**Experience & Technical Background**

* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in a development or engineering environment across Cloud migrations, DevOps, AI or SRE.
* Hands-on ownership of end-to-end delivery of platforms and products built on a modern technology stack (microservices, cloud, DevOps).
* Knowledge of cloud concepts, DevOps and AI principles and practices.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies, applied to project management in cloud, DevOps and AI environments.
* Basic understanding of automation and scripting, security best practices, and Infrastructure as Code.

**Core Skills & Attributes**

* Strong leadership qualities to guide and motivate teams towards project success.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate project goals clearly, expectations, and progress to stakeholders, team members, and clients, supported by effective listening and negotiation skills.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and resources effectively.
* Strong problem-solving skills to identify issues, analyze alternatives, and implement appropriate solutions promptly.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of adjusting plans and strategies as needed.
* Ability to maintain composure, stay focused, and handle pressure while keeping the project on track.

**License / Certification**

* At least one of PSM, PMP, CSM, or a certification in any Agile project management methodology. SAFe certification is preferred.  
    
  **What You Can Expect**

This is a delivery role with real ownership attached to it. Here is what the day-to-day looks like and what the role gives back.

* **Ownership from the start:** You will run projects end to end - planning, governance, customer communication, and closure - rather than supporting someone else's plan.
* **Technical breadth:** Direct exposure across cloud migration and modernization, infrastructure, managed operations, and AI engagements, delivered for global clients in FinTech, EdTech, Healthcare, Automotive, and Media Tech.
* **Access to senior expertise:** You will work daily with Architects, Technical Leads, and the Director - Delivery, with solution reviews and escalation paths that build your technical judgment over time.
* **Customer-facing exposure:** You will be the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders, which builds the communication and negotiation skills that shape a long-term delivery career.
* **A defined path forward:** A structured performance and feedback framework, with clarity on what growth looks like in the Delivery function.
* **Scope beyond the job description:** Opportunities to contribute to pre-sales, delivery process improvement, and internal governance as you build credibility.

**Equal opportunity employer**

CloudifyOps is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:

**Who are we?**

We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.**

**Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia.**

**What is this role all about?**

**Dive into the heart of product innovation where you'll shape cutting-edge AI-driven CX solutions, collaborate with top talent, and drive real impact for global enterprises—all while accelerating your growth in product management.**

**Sounds interesting?**

**Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**

* **Collaborate with senior product managers and stakeholders to define bold product visions, strategies, and roadmaps that propel Kapture forward.**
* **Dive deep into market research and competitor analysis, uncovering trends, customer needs, and game-changing opportunities for enhancements.**
* **Gather and document razor-sharp product requirements from stakeholders, customers, and feedback, turning insights into actionable plans.**
* **Partner with UX/UI teams to craft intuitive designs that deliver exceptional user experiences, then coordinate with engineering for seamless, high-impact launches.**
* **Analyze performance metrics and user feedback to fuel data-driven decisions, while testing features and maintaining crystal-clear communication across teams.**

**This is a Bengaluru-based role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.**

**What does success look like in this role?**

**You'll excel by delivering features that wow clients, hit key metrics like user adoption and satisfaction, and contribute to roadmaps that keep Kapture ahead of the CX curve.**

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**

**Here are the basic requirements:**

* **Hold a bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, with 1-3 years of experience in product management, SaaS, or related roles.**
* **Demonstrate strong analytical skills and familiarity with product metrics, market research tools, and customer feedback processes.**
* **Show proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and stakeholder teams.**

* **Analyze metrics and feedback to drive iterative improvements and informed decisions.**

**You will have an advantage if you:**

* **Have hands-on experience with AI-powered SaaS products or CX platforms.**
* **Are skilled in tools like Jira, Figma, or analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude).**
* **Bring prior exposure to agile methodologies or product testing/validation processes.**
* **Have built relationships across sales, marketing, and customer success for successful launches.**

**Why should you be interested?**

**Here’s what you will gain from this role:**

* **Hands-on experience shaping AI-driven products for global enterprises, fast-tracking your product management career.**
* **Collaboration with industry leaders in a high-growth SaaS environment, plus mentorship from senior PMs.**
* **Ownership of impactful features used by Fortune 500 clients, with clear paths to promotion.**
* **A vibrant Bangalore office culture with perks like flexible growth opportunities and innovation-driven projects.**

**Does this sound like you?**

**Click the Apply button to let us know!**

title: Manager, Data Scientist
description:
**Overview:**

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What We're Looking For:**

Job Title: Manager, Data Science – Retail & CPG
  
Department: Customer Success, Software Sales & Services (Workcloud SaaS Professional Services)
  
Technology Stack: Databricks Unified Analytics Platform, Microsoft Azure Lakehouse Platform & Modern GenAI/Agentic AI Stacks
  
Location: Hybrid - Bangalore
  
Employment Type: Full-Time

**About the Role & Business Unit**

Retail and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) supply chains operate in dynamic, high-stakes environments where every decision—from what to stock to how to price—hinges on knowing what customer demand will look like tomorrow.

Our team delivers enterprise-grade SaaS decision management solutions on Microsoft Azure and Databricks. At the foundation of our platform is a cutting-edge Time Series Demand Forecasting engine, which directly powers downstream optimization applications including:

* Inventory Allocation & Replenishment
* Assortment Planning & Store Clustering
* Initial Pricing, Promotions, and Markdown Optimization
* Predictive Ordering, and Size & Pack Optimization
* Intelligent Order Promising
* Retail Shrink, Fraud, & Supply Chain Anomaly Detection
* Workforce & Labor Scheduling Optimization

As the Manager, Data Science, you will occupy a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of people mentorship, customer engagement, technical architecture, and GenAI transformation. You will lead a dedicated pod of data scientists, own enterprise client relationships from an analytical standpoint, shape the strategic roadmap of our core SaaS products, and spearhead the adoption of GenAI, LLMs, and Agentic AI to drastically accelerate team productivity and drive scalable professional services delivery.

**Key Responsibilities & What You’ll Do**

**1. People Leadership & Talent Development**

* **Lead & Mentor a High-Performing Pod:** Directly manage, mentor, and coach a focused team of 2–3 junior/associate data scientists and interns.
* **Technical Guidance & Quality Standards:** Conduct rigorous code, model, and methodology reviews to ensure high analytical fidelity, production-readiness, and adherence to ML best practices.
* **Career Growth:** Set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, foster a culture of continuous learning, and help team members rapidly upskill across our cloud lakehouse and AI-native SaaS ecosystem.

**2. Customer Engagement & Professional Services Delivery**

* **Lead Client Analytics Engagements:** Act as the primary data science leader and trusted advisor for enterprise retail/CPG customer stakeholders (Directors, VPs of Supply Chain, Merchandising, and IT).
* Scope & Expectation Management: Translate ambiguous customer business problems into concrete mathematical and data science roadmaps; scope deliverables, negotiate commitments, and proactively manage project timelines and expectations.
* **Executive Storytelling & Value Delivery:** Communicate complex predictive and prescriptive model behaviors (e.g., promotional lift, price elasticity curves, allocation trade-offs) in plain, business-centric language that demonstrates clear ROI.

**3. GenAI & Agentic-AI Operational Transformation**

* **Drive Professional Services Scalability:** Lead the exploration, design, and internal rollout of GenAI and Agentic-AI capabilities to 10x the productivity and delivery speed of our professional services organization.
* **Automate Core Data & Deployment Workflows:** Architect agentic workflows for autonomous data discovery, schema mapping, and ETL migration, drastically reducing customer onboarding lead time.
* **Innovate Frontier AI Capabilities:** Spearhead the application of LLMs and foundation models to solve complex domain challenges—such as automated forecast validation, natural-language root-cause generation, promotional cannibalization modeling, and "cold-start" demand intelligence for zero-history new product or new store launches.

**4. SaaS Product Innovation & Thought Leadership**

* **Bridge Services to Product:** Identify recurring customer requirements and algorithmic customizations, partnering closely with Product Management and Core Engineering to productize them into standard, reusable SaaS platform features.
* **Algorithmic & Architecture Leadership:** Provide hands-on architectural direction across statistical baselines, gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost), deep learning/neural network models (TiDE, DenseNet), foundation time-series models (TimesFM, Chronos), and mathematical optimization algorithms.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Master’s or Ph.D. (or equivalent practical experience) in Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* **Professional Experience:** 8+ years of progressive data science experience, including at least 1–2 years of demonstrated technical team mentorship, leadership, project / program management, or direct people management.
* **Client Engagement & Stakeholder Mastery:** Proven track record in customer-facing analytics delivery (e.g., enterprise SaaS professional services, management/analytics consulting, or internal corporate stakeholder management).
* **Core Technical Depth:**
  + Strong expertise in time series forecasting, classical statistical modeling (hierarchical forecasting, intermittent demand, temporal sequence modeling), machine learning, and deep learning/neural networks
  + Deep proficiency in Python, SQL, and standard data science packages (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn).
  + Hands-on experience with cloud lakehouse architectures (Databricks, Azure, PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow).
* **GenAI / LLM Practical Acumen:** Working knowledge of modern GenAI paradigms (prompt engineering, RAG, tool calling, multi-agent frameworks like LangChain/AutoGen/CrewAI) and a clear vision for how to apply them to operational workflows.
* **Executive Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge deep mathematical concepts with C-suite business strategy.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience in Retail, CPG, or Supply Chain Management decision systems (e.g., inventory replenishment, price elasticity, markdown optimization, assortment planning).
* Strong background in Operations Research & Mathematical Optimization (Linear/Mixed-Integer Programming with PuLP, SciPy.optimize, OR-Tools, or Gurobi).
* Experience productizing custom professional services algorithms into reusable multi-tenant SaaS modules.

**What We Offer**

* **High-Visibility Leadership:** Serve as a core technical and client-facing leader shaping the AI direction of an enterprise SaaS platform.
* **Bleeding-Edge Tech Stack:** Build on modern enterprise infrastructure combining Databricks Lakehouse, state-of-the-art time series foundation models, and custom Agentic-AI pipelines.
* **Impact & Scalability:** Direct ownership of strategies that improve multi-million-dollar supply chain efficiencies for global retail brands while transforming our internal delivery economics.

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

**AI Technology Statement:**

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy .
